Interface SmallModelEditor

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
BuildingsRefillDTO, ChooseTotemColorDTO, EndGameDTO, EraChangeDTO, ErrorDTO, EventResolvedDTO, GameResumeDTO, LeaderboardChangeDTO, LobbyInitializedDTO, MesosStartedDTO, PhaseChangeDTO, PickBottomBuildingsDTO, PickBottomRowDTO, PickTopBuildingsDTO, PickTopRowDTO, PlayerJoinedLobbyDTO, PlayerRecapDTO, PlayerResourcesChangeDTO, PlayerStateChangeDTO, RoundChangeDTO, TopRowRefillDTO, TotemOfferMoveDTO, TotemTurnMoveDTO
public interface SmallModelEditor extends Serializable
The core contract for any update packet hopping over the network. Needs to know how to patch its changes into the local SmallModel.

      void edit(SmallModel smallModel) throws IllegalStateException, Error
      Applies this tiny diff straight onto the live client model.
      Parameters:
      smallModel - The client's small model.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - When the internal state doesn't allow this change.
      Error - On critical failures during the application.
